data.solutionSummary: Memory grant failure (error 8645), not a runtime timeout: the WITH chain planned as one statement asked ~1.8GB where the instance grants ~154MB. Split into 15 SELECT..INTO #Cte so each statement gets its own grant, index each temp on its probe key, force LOOP JOIN + MAX_GRANT_PERCENT=5 on the final assembly, and raise the adapter requestTimeout from a fixed 120s to a configurable 1_800_000ms.
